facts.statement: Buying a $10 Station Cash card at Walmart also gave an in-game Walmart t-shirt.
facts.quote: When you buy a $10 Station Cash® card at Walmart, you also get an in-game Walmart t-shirt!

article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash® Exclusive with Walmart!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (shown on the Portuguese-language page) promoting double Station Cash for SOE Pre-Paid Game Cards bought and redeemed at US Walmart stores during October 12-14, 2012. It also says a $10 Station Cash card bought at Walmart comes with an in-game Walmart t-shirt. The page gives no exact post date; it only says it was published 4 weeks and 1 day before capture.
